_about: Bretton Oaks (Alex, 2026-11-17: 'a suburban area called Bretton Oaks ... very similar houses ... circling a cul-de-sac ... where the NPCs go at night to sleep'), built by scripts/suburb.gd. centre: the middle of the turning circle [x, z]; bulb: its radius; ring: how far each house's middle stands from the centre; road_to: where the road in meets the meadow trail [x, z]; road_width. houses: one per house, round the circle from just past the road (start_deg from the road's direction, step_deg between them); mirror flips it left for right; brick, vinyl (the cream siding), trim and door are colours; plants: [model in assets/props, x, z, scale] in the house's own space (its front toward +z, the right wing's front at z 4.4), arborvitae and red_shrub are the photo's. residents: who sleeps in which house (a named villager's id -> house index); anyone else (townsfolk) is given a house by home_for(), the same one every time. night_from / night_to: when they go home to bed and come out again (game hours). lights: windows lit from dusk until about this hour (each house a little later than the last), and again from lights_morning before dawn. Every name here is a draft until Alex approves it.
name: Bretton Oaks
